title: Patient Financial Services Guidance — Cost Sharing on a Claim in Appeal and the Hardship Supplement
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), insurer cost sharing on the claim under appeal is taken off the medical debt a hardship supplement claims.

**The claim under appeal.** The claim under appeal is the claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity), while that claim is in appealed status; when that claim has left appealed status, there is no claim under appeal.

**What is taken off.**
- When the most recent appeal is a member appeal filed under the patient's authorization and its claim is the claim under appeal, the deductible, coinsurance and copay liabilities of the twelve months posted from that claim are taken off.
- When the most recent appeal is of any other type and its claim is the claim under appeal, only the coinsurance liabilities of the twelve months posted from that claim are taken off.
- Otherwise nothing is taken off for an appeal.

The liabilities are those posted on the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) ledgers from that claim. A whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it; a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day, so that a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside.

### Judgement table

| Most recent appeal | Its claim | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| member appeal under the patient's authorization | in appealed status | deductible, coinsurance and copay liabilities of the twelve months from that claim |
| any other appeal type | in appealed status | coinsurance liabilities of the twelve months from that claim |
| any type | has left appealed status | nothing |
| no appeal on file | — | nothing |

Hypothetical: a member appeal is pending on a claim from which 300.00 deductible, 200.00 coinsurance and 50.00 copay were posted in the twelve months; 550.00 is taken off. Had the same appeal been of another type, 200.00 would be taken off.
